title.narrative: Complementing EU Support for Agricultural Restructuring Project (CESAR)

description.narrative: The objective of the Complementing EU Support for Agricultural Restructuring Project of Romania is to facilitate market-based farm restructuring through enhancing the ability of farmers, farm family members, and farm workers to manage their assets and income. Under this overarching objective, the Project will assist the Government of Romania (GOR) in completing the property title registration of land assets in rural areas to improve the security of land property rights and reduce transaction costs on rural land markets. Equally important, the Project will assist the GOR in improving the delivery of guidance services that enable the agricultural population to manage more sustainable its income and assets and thus contribute to the absorption of available national and EU support programs. The Project will consist of three components: (i) Land Administration which will support the completion of property rights determination and registration of land assets in rural areas, thereby improving the security of property rights and the functioning of rural land markets; (ii) Socio-Economic Guidance Services to the Agricultural Population which seeks to increase the ability of the agricultural population to manage its income and assets under consideration of national and EU support programs; and (iii) Policy, Strategy and Management which seeks to assist the GOR in improving its capacity to develop strategies associated with sectoral restructuring, as well as with EU integration, and pertaining to the policy fields supported under Components 1 and 2.

The objective of this Project is to facilitate market-based farm restructuring through enhancing the ability of farmers, farm family members, and farm workers to manage their assets and income. Under this overarching objective, the Project will assist the Government of Romania (GOR) in (i) completing the property title registration of land assets in rural areas and (ii) improving the delivery of socio-economic guidance services to the agricultural population.
